description: Implementation of an epoll-based IO broker handling asynchronous file descriptor events, registration, deregistration, and thread management.

classes.name: io_broker_epoll
classes.description: Class managing epoll-based asynchronous IO event handling, including registration, deregistration, and event loop.

methods.name: io_broker_epoll
methods.description: Constructor initializing epoll, control event fd, and starting the event handling thread.

methods.name: ~io_broker_epoll
methods.description: Destructor stopping the thread, cleaning up resources, and deregistering file descriptors.

methods.name: rearm_fd
methods.description: Rearms a file descriptor in epoll interest list.

methods.name: thread_loop
methods.description: Main event loop processing epoll events, handling errors, and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: enqueue_event
methods.description: Adds a control event to the event queue and triggers epoll to wake up the thread.

methods.name: handle_enqueued_events
methods.description: Processes control events such as register/deregister file descriptors and shutdown commands.

methods.name: handle_fd_registration
methods.description: Registers a new file descriptor with epoll and associates callbacks.

methods.name: handle_fd_epoll_removal
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from epoll interest list, optionally forwarding errors.

methods.name: register_fd
methods.description: Public method to register a file descriptor with callbacks, thread-safe.

methods.name: unregister_fd
methods.description: Public method to deregister a file descriptor, thread-safe.

methods.name: stop_impl
methods.description: Stops the event loop, deregisters all file descriptors, and cleans up resources.
